description: This PHP script serves as an entry point for the jjwg_Maps module in a SugarCRM-based project. It handles both cron-triggered geocoding operations and passing selected record data from list views to the map display module, including redirecting via a dynamically generated HTML form.

classes.name: jjwg_MapsController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling map operations, including geocoding addresses.

methods.name: action_geocode_addresses
methods.description: Method invoked to perform address geocoding, used during cron jobs.
